subject: Re: Access Management questionnaire & SCIM attribute mapping (RFP follow-up)
thread_content:
Message 1 (original request)
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecorp.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access management questionnaire for RFP - ACME

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking our call last week. Attached is the identity & access management worksheet from our vendor security team — we need Redwood to complete sections on SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, RBAC, admin controls, and logging for our RFP evaluation.

Primary asks:
- Confirm SSO protocols supported and typical configuration steps (IdP-initiated, SP-initiated).
- SCIM: which attributes are provisioned by default, can we toggle provisioning of custom attributes?
- RBAC: can we create organization-level roles and fine-grained resource-level permissions?
- Admin audit trails: retention, export formats, and access controls.

Can you return a completed worksheet and any supporting docs by EOD Thu? Procurement flagged a tight schedule.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Senior Security Engineer, AcmeCorp
security@acmecorp.com

Attachment: Acme_RFP_Identity_Questions_v3.xlsx (worksheet)

---
Message 2 (initial Redwood reply)
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access management questionnaire for RFP - ACME

Alex —

Thanks for the worksheet and the clear priorities. We can meet the timeline. I attached a short summary and a SCIM mapping template to speed things up. High-level answers below; we will populate your spreadsheet and return it by Thu EOD:

- SSO: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC (Auth Code + PKCE). Both IdP-init and SP-init flows supported. We also offer IdP metadata import and automated cert rotation.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 provisioning supported. Default attributes: userName, name (givenName, familyName), emails, active, groups. Custom attributes can be mapped via our SCIM extension layer and toggled per-organization. Sync mode supports create/update/delete with scoped filters.
- RBAC: Org-level roles (Owner, Admin, Developer, Billing) and resource-level permissions (model deployments, routes, billing) with allow/deny policies. Role templates + custom roles supported.
- Audit logs: All admin actions, provisioning events, and SSO logs captured. Retention default 90 days (configurable to 7 years for Private deployments). Exports in CSV/JSON and streaming to customer SIEM via syslog or secure webhook.

I cc'd Marissa (security engineering) and Laura (sales lead) to confirm the SCIM attribute list and show pricing impact for provisioning volume.

Regards,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_SCIM_Mapping_Template.csv

---
Message 3 (technical clarification from Acme)
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecorp.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access management questionnaire for RFP - ACME

Nikhil — quick follow-up (apologies for the detail):
- For provisioning, we need to know whether group membership changes are pushed in real time or batched. Our HR system triggers bulk changes during onboarding windows.
- Does your SCIM implement PATCH semantics for partial updates?
- For OIDC, do you support token introspection endpoints for token revocation detection?

Thanks — Alex

---
Message 4 (internal coordination forwarded by Nikhil)
From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Access management questionnaire for RFP - ACME (questions on SCIM/Patch & batching)

Team — forwarding Alex's follow-ups. Please see inline notes below; need final wording for the RFP worksheet and an estimate on ops cost if they require <5 min near-real-time group sync.

Inline:
> "group membership changes pushed in real time or batched?"
- Marissa: our SCIM service supports immediate push (near-real-time) for single events and can be configured for batching windows; latency depends on volume and provisioning plan. For Hosted customers, default batching window is 5 minutes; Dedicated/Private can be configured to sub-minute where supported.

> "PATCH semantics for partial updates?"
- Neha: yes, SCIM PATCH is implemented per RFC7644; we support add, replace, remove operations and attribute-level conditional updates.

> "OIDC token introspection?"
- Marissa: we expose token introspection endpoints for short-lived access tokens and support token revocation via the introspection and admin revocation API. For maximum security, tokens can be bound to sessions and revoked from the admin console.

Action: Marissa & Neha, please produce 2–3 sentences we can paste into the spreadsheet. Laura/Ben — confirm any commercial note on sub-minute sync as it impacts commit sizing.

Thanks,
Nikhil

---
Message 5 (final reply with attachments and completed worksheet)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access management questionnaire for RFP - ACME

Alex —

Appended is the completed worksheet and three supporting docs: a SCIM attribute mapping CSV we filled with default and optional fields, an SSO/OIDC notes PDF that describes configuration steps and endpoints, and a short summary of audit log retention options. Highlights:

- Group membership: near-real-time push supported; default hosted batching = 5 minutes. Sub-minute sync (<=60s) is available on Dedicated and Private with a small provisioning surcharge (we included commercial note in the sheet).
- PATCH semantics: implemented per RFC7644 (supports add/replace/remove).
- Token introspection & revocation: introspection endpoint available; admin revocation API supports immediate token invalidation.
- SCIM custom attributes: supported via our extension field mapping; per-attribute toggles supported at org-level.
- RBAC: custom roles with resource-scoped permissions; recommended best practice doc included in SSO_OIDC_Notes.pdf.

Files attached: Acme_RFP_Identity_Questions_v3_completed.xlsx, Redwood_SCIM_Mapping_Template.csv, Redwood_SSO_OIDC_Notes.pdf

Next steps: if you want, we can schedule a 30-min technical walk-through (Marissa + Neha) this week to review mapping and provisioning windows.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
